<!-- Title: a Conventional Commit, e.g. "fix(console): keep the scrubber inside the panel". It becomes the squash commit. -->

## Problem

<!-- What is wrong or missing, and for whom. Link the issue. -->

## Evidence

<!-- How we know: trace IDs, log lines, screenshots, a failing check. -->

## Change

<!-- What this does, in a few lines. -->

## Tests

<!-- What proves it: new or changed tests, and how you ran them. -->

## Risk

<!-- What could go wrong, and what it touches (workflows, deploy/, dependencies, policy). "Low" is an answer. -->

## Rollout

<!-- How it reaches the cluster, and how to undo it. -->
